in_sanskrit.name: शिष्पाल
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: शिष् (shisha) - to learn, पाल (pal) - to rule, master, possess. A learned ruler or master.

in_hindi.name: शिष्पाल
in_hindi.meaning: पाला (palaa) - to rule, master, शिष् (shisha) - to learn. A learned ruler or master.

in_tamil.name: சிஷ்பால்
in_tamil.meaning: ஜ்ஞானம் அல்லது அடிகள் (jñanam allathu adikal) - learned ones or masters
in_tamil.long_meaning: சிஷ் (cish) - learned, பால் (pal) - to rule, master, possess. A learned ruler or master.

in_telugu.name: శిష్పాల్
in_telugu.long_meaning: శిష్ (cish) - learned, పాల్ (pal) - to rule, master, possess. A learned ruler or master.

in_marathi.name: Shishpal
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Universe
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shishpal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who holds the universe in his hands, Shishpal is a name that signifies immense power and control over all aspects of life. Derived from Sanskrit words shishi, meaning 'lord', and pal, meaning 'of the universe', this name is a reminder of the immense potential within each of us to shape our reality.
